charts.title: Research coverage
charts.description: Editorial source-index inspection; automated fetches are excluded.
charts.note: Not inspected includes every index without a recorded editorial inspection; this is not proof of missed stories.

charts.title: Image attempts and rework
charts.description: Accepted and rejected candidates for each final image.
charts.note: Generation attempts measure rework, not runtime or cost. Quality and publication checks remain separate.

charts.title: Top 10 links to published items
charts.description: Unique published items by format, not the number of topic mappings.
charts.note: No selection quota. Topic linkage does not establish better quality, popularity or causal improvement.

interpretation: One edition at a time. Missing evidence is not zero. Trend claims require comparable recorded cycles.
